meta.name: Orblob Design DNA
meta.description: High-precision technical visual identity extracted from cobe.vercel.app with light/dark duality, electric cobalt ink accent, and WebGL dot-matrix globe graphics.

primary.role: Signature electric cobalt ink brand accent, interactive elements, active tabs, CTA buttons

secondary.role: Deep carbon navy text and high-contrast structural borders

accent.role: Focal points, active indicators, globe highlight and arc illumination

neutral.usage: Elevated surfaces, crisp 1px borders, muted technical labels, and high-readability body text across light and dark modes

color.contrast_strategy: High contrast technical editorial with deliberate stark monochrome and electric cobalt punch

typography.font_style_notes: Precision engineering micro-typography with tracked uppercase monospace tags and crisp geometric body sans

spacing.section_rhythm: Dense 1px bordered grid panels with structured 12px/16px padding

shape.border_usage: crisp 1px / 1.5px borders defining panels and controls

elevation.depth_cues: layering, sharp borders, and WebGL depth instead of blur/heavy shadows

motion.philosophy: Snappy, restrained, utility-focused, no frivolous decorative delay

components.button_style: Sharp 6px radius, solid ink or bordered ghost, uppercase monospace tracking
components.card_style: Bordered pane with 0px or 6px radius, background surface
components.navigation_pattern: Top bar with segmented tool modes (Design, Code, Preview, Export)
components.modal_style: Crisp bordered dialog with subtle backdrop
components.list_style: 1px bordered cell rows with hover highlight
components.component_notes: Figma/Framer level inspector density with segmented sliders and numeric steppers

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Precision laboratory instrument and satellite navigation workstation

visual_language.whitespace_usage: efficient functional padding with prominent canvas focus
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Centralized live viewport surrounded by dense utility panels
visual_language.focal_strategy: Single hero WebGL globe canvas with anchored real-time HUD overlays
visual_language.texture_usage: Procedural WebGL point-matrix sampling on dark/light background

composition.hierarchy_method: Typographic scale and spatial grid partitioning
composition.flow_direction: Top-down workflow with left-to-right inspection pipeline
composition.grouping_strategy: Bordered panel cards with segmented collapsible sections
composition.negative_space_role: Breathing room for 3D globe rotation and interaction

imagery.graphic_elements: orbital rings, crosshairs, latitude/longitude grids, beacon points
imagery.pattern_usage: Fibonacci point distribution and subtle technical grid lines

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Instantaneous WebGL state reflection without React rerender lag
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Subtle background fill and border color shift

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative (Export Code, Add Marker, Save Cloud)
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Structured instructional prompt with one-click preset action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Precise diagnostic message with recovery button

overview.fallback_strategy: graceful WebGL context loss recovery, WebGL1/Canvas fallback, reduced-motion static render
overview.primary_technology: WebGL2 with custom GLSL raymarching shaders

background_effects.description: Atmospheric horizon rim lighting computed per-pixel in fragment shader

particle_systems.description: Fibonacci spiral point sampling on the sphere surface mapped to land/water mask

3d_elements.description: Interactive 3D WebGL2 sphere with custom lighting, camera pitch/yaw, instanced markers, and bezier arcs

params.lighting: Diffuse directional + ambient + atmospheric rim glow
params.camera: Orthographic/Perspective hybrid with phi/theta spherical rotation
params.materials: Custom GLSL procedural dot shader + instanced billboard shaders
params.geometry: Full-screen raymarching quad + instanced triangle ribbons
params.interaction_model: Trackball-style inertia drag, pinch zoom, click ray-casting

shader_effects.description: Raymarched Fibonacci sphere, instanced marker discs, and quadratic Bezier ribbon strips

params.vertex_manipulation: Ribbon normal extrusion along quadratic Bezier curve
params.fragment_output: Procedural antialiased circle discard with rim glow

text_effects.description: SVG textPath rotating smoothly along an inclined 3D orbit ring around the globe

cursor_effects.description: Grab / grabbing cursor during 3D globe manipulation

canvas_drawings.description: High-frequency WebGL render loop for continuous 60fps globe rotation and marker pulsing

svg_animations.description: Rotating SVG text orbit rings around the globe
svg_animations.technology: SVG textPath with CSS rotateX and rotate transform

visual_effects.composite_notes: The system combines a 6-vertex full-screen quad raymarched Fibonacci sphere, instanced GPU billboard quads for markers, instanced 66-vertex Bezier ribbon strips for arcs, and projected 2D coordinates driving CSS anchor variables (--cobe-*) or DOM overlays for labels. Studio controls update typed Zustand store, which directly syncs to the WebGL uniforms without triggering React virtual DOM thrashing.
